minor.issue: Body validation still runs before X-Admin-Password header check (returns 422 without header) — carried from previous iterations, non-blocking.

integration_issues.issue: Race between initial render (isMobile=false → desktop <source>) and post-mount useEffect flipping isMobile=true. On page load at 390px, the <video> element sometimes commits with currentSrc=/media/dachwohnung.webm (desktop) instead of dachwohnung-mobile.webm. Observed in one of two runs. Fix: initialise isMobile with `typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.innerWidth < 768` (SSR-safe) so the very first render already emits mobile <source> tags; or call v.load() after the isMobile flip inside a useEffect.

issues: getComputedStyle(canvas).touchAction returned 'auto' instead of the claimed 'pan-y'. Vertical page scroll still works, but the explicit pan-y hint is not being applied. Minor CSS tweak: add `touch-action:pan-y !important` to the canvas element (Objekte.jsx or DigitalTwin.jsx) if the exact pan-y behaviour is required.

When prefers-reduced-motion: reduce is emulated the poster renders but the promised data-testid='hero-play' button is NOT in the DOM. Spec says 'poster + play button'. Minor: either render the play button in the reduced-motion branch too, or drop the button from the spec.

rca of the issue: Dachwohnung mobile-source race: ListingPicture uses `useState(false)` for isMobile + a mount-time useEffect to setIsMobile(true) on width<768. First render therefore emits only desktop <source> tags; the <video> element resolves currentSrc synchronously from those. On the subsequent React update the mobile <source> tags mount, but HTMLMediaElement does NOT automatically call load() when children change, so currentSrc stays on the desktop file. Repro: cold-load /  at 390px and inspect video[src*='dachwohnung'].currentSrc — half the time you see /media/dachwohnung.webm instead of /media/dachwohnung-mobile.webm. Mitigation: (a) lazy-init state `useState(() => typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.innerWidth < 768)`, or (b) `useEffect(() => { videoEl.load(); }, [isMobile])`.
